programme.title: How He Fell in Love
programme.desc: Travis, a struggling young musician, crosses paths with Ellen, an older, married yoga instructor who is in the process of adopting a child. Travis and Ellen begin an affair that slowly deepens into something more intimate and profound. As their encounters continue, Travis must face the consequences of infidelity while Ellen is confronted with her crumbling marriage.

programme.title: Days of the Bagnold Summer
programme.desc: Coming-of-age comedy starring Earl Cave (son of singer Nick) as a heavy-metal-loving teenager who is forced to spend the summer with his boring old mum, in Simon Bird's (The Inbetweeners) debut feature in the director's chair. Daniel (Cave) is all set for six weeks in Florida with his dad and his dad's pregnant wife, Bernie. The weather will be fantastic, and he'll get to drive his father's MG convertible. Meanwhile, his mum (Monica Dolan) won't let him drive the Vauxhall Astra and she never gets her own cake, but instead nicks bits of his. So, when Bernie calls to say that Daniel won't be able to come to Florida, Daniel is obviously not very happy. Can a Metallica-loving, black-clad teenager with Tippexed emblems on his shoes have any fun with a middle-aged librarian who wears comfortable sandals? Well, she is his mum... Also starring Tamsin Greig and Rob Brydon. Network Premiere.

programme.title: That's What I Am
programme.desc: A coming-of-age story set in 1965 that follows 12-year-old Andy Nichol (Chase Ellison), a bright student who, like most kids his age, will do anything to avoid conflict for fear of suffering overwhelming ridicule and punishment from his junior high school peers. Everyone's favorite teacher, Mr. Simon (Ed Harris), pairs Andy with the school's biggest outcast and social pariah, Stanley, aka "Big G" (Alexander Walters), on a critical term project. Sporting thick orange hair, a head too big for his body and ears too big for his head, "Big G" has been the object of ridicule since grade school. Before long, Andy will learn that there was truly a method behind Mr. Simon's madness as to why he teamed these two up. As the story unfolds, Mr. Simon finds himself the target of a malicious rumor after Principal Kelner (Amy Madigan) suspends a school bully for brutally beating up a female classmate whom he thinks has "cooties."

programme.title: Waking Ned
programme.desc: The lucky winner of the national lottery is Ned Devine, so taken by his good fortune that he now can't be waked, because he died from the shock of it! News of the win spread quickly in the scenic little Irish village of Tully More, but not the secret news of Ned's demise. With lottery officials closing in to confirm the prize claimed by the deceased Devine, Ned's closest friends scheme to keep the prize money close to home, in memory of Ned of course! But as the plot twists humorously, they learn it is hard is to keep such a secret in a small town.

programme.title: The Butler
programme.desc: The Butler (2013) is an American historical drama directed by Lee Daniels and starring Forest Whitaker and Oprah Winfrey. At the White House an elderly butler named Cecil Gaines is waiting for the newly inaugurated president Barack Obama. While waiting, the butler recounts his life story and all the former US presidents he served. A butler's job requires keeping what you heard to yourself and doing your job unnoticed. Serving eight presidents during his tenure, Cecil observed how American society was changing and even he has felt these changes.

programme.title: Thunderpants
programme.desc: An 11-year-old boy's amazing ability to break wind leads him first to fame and then to death row before it helps him to fulfil his ambition of becoming an astronaut.

programme.title: Look of Nothing (Mine de rien)
programme.desc: In a small town in the North of France, a region that was the flagship of the mining industry for many years, young and old alike are struggling to find work. While several former workers decide to hold a siege in front of a disused coal mine that is to be dismantled, two long-term unemployed men, Di Lello, whose wife runs the household, and Arnaud, a divorced man who has to take care of his sick mother, have the excellent idea of building an "artisanal" amusement park. By saving the mine and its memory, they will regain strength and dignity.

programme.title: Swallows and Amazons
programme.desc: Four children dream of escaping the tedium of a summer holiday with their mother. When finally given permission to camp on their own on an island in the middle of a vast lake in the Lake District, they are overjoyed. But when they get there they discover they may not be alone. The battle for ownership of a lonely island teaches them the skills of survival, the value of friendship and the importance of holding your nerve. Based on the novel by Arthur Ransome.

programme.title: Tenor
programme.desc: While working part-time as a food deliveryman, Antoine, an aspiring young rapper from the suburbs of Paris, meets Mrs. Loiseau, an eminent teacher at the Paris Opéra. Stunned by the young man's raw talent, she introduces him to the world of opera. As Antoine becomes one of Mrs. Loiseau's students, he hides his new dream from his friends and family, fearing that they won't understand - this double life burdens him... Somewhere in between the gilded and uptight Parisian upper-class, and the harsh yet free-spirited and familiar suburbs he grew up in, Antoine will have to find his own voice.

programme.title: Mozart and the Whale
programme.desc: A love story between two savants with Asperger's syndrome, a kind of autism whose effects sabotage their budding relationship.

programme.title: Beauty And the Beast
programme.desc: A widowed merchant moves to the countryside with his six children after going bankrupt. His youngest daughter, Belle, is the only one happy with the change. When the merchant's lost ship is found, he plans to reclaim his assets. On the way, he encounters the Beast's magical domain, where his needs are met. However, he is caught picking a rose and must return to the castle or his family will be killed. Feeling responsible, Belle offers herself in her father's place.

programme.title: Escobar: Paradise Lost
programme.desc: Nick Brady and his girlfriend Maria, Pablo Escobar's niece, are making hurried plans to leave Colombia with Nick's brother, Dylan, when Escobar summons Nick to a meeting. He tells the gathered men, many of whom are his family, that he intends to surrender himself to the authorities and that they will have to take action in his absence to protect his fortune. Most of the men agree immediately. Nick is visibly hesitant but agrees when Pablo asks him directly for his help.

programme.title: Investigating Sex
programme.desc: A group of men and two female stenographers scientifically study sex.

programme.title: Costa Brava, Lebanon
programme.desc: Members of a family who quit the polluted, rubbish-strewn city of Beirut for an idyllic mountain home. However, their dreams of a utopian existence are shattered by the construction of a landfill on the boundary of their land.

programme.title: Hara-Kiri: Death of a Samurai
programme.desc: A tale of revenge, honor and disgrace, centering on a poverty-stricken samurai who discovers the fate of his ronin son-in-law, setting in motion a tense showdown of vengeance against the house of a feudal lord.

programme.title: Tanked
programme.desc: Follow aquarium enthusiasts Brett Raymer and Wayde King as they attempt to build some of the most luxurious fish tanks in the world. At Acrylic Tank Manufacturing, the brothers-in-law guide you through the design process and the building of their truly jaw-dropping aquariums. Experience the unveiling of finished tanks housed everywhere from restaurants and banks, to glamorous casinos and mansions. Join the duo in their Las Vegas workshop as they deliver some budget-shattering builds to their high-profile clientele.

programme.title: Animal Cops: Houston
programme.desc: Animal Cops - Houston is the third Animal Planet series to follow the work of animal cruelty investigators. This particular series follows the animal cruelty investigators of the Houston Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (HSPCA). This team of 8 investigators works in a large area of Texas investigating reports of animal cruelty and, when necessary, removing animals from horrible abuse situations. Since these investigators do not have arrest or warrant seeking powers on their own, they work closely with local law enforcement, including the Harris County Precinct One Constable's Office. This office has permantly assigned Deputy Constable Christine Kendrick to assist the HSPCA investigators with any law enforcement issue that arises, including seeking warrents and arresting those charged with animal cruelty.

programme.title: Animal Cops: Houston

programme.title: Big Fish Man
programme.desc: World record-holding angler Jakub Vagner would die for fishing and has come close more than once. In Big Fish Man he embarks on extreme fishing expeditions to the most remote regions of the world in search of fish that have never before been filmed in the wild many weighing more than 200kg and measuring over six metres in length. His exploits take us to a variety of remote locations Congo, Mongolia, Europe, Canada, Thailand, Ecuador and Peru. Carrying all his kit and supplies, Jakub spends days trekking through unforgiving jungle and paddling against wild river currents. He survives using the hunting and foraging skills hes honed over almost two decades of fishing missions. On his visually stunning adventure he tries to land the Amazons largest freshwater fish in Ecuador and the mighty Goliath Tiger Fish, with its 32 shark-like teeth, in Congo. He enlists the help of nomadic reindeer herders to land a giant Taimen in the ice cold rapids of the Shishgid River in Mongolia and tries to catch a massive Northern Pike in the Canadian sub-Arctic even though their natural habitat is completely frozen over. The series is packed with drama and danger. Jakub is stubborn and determined as time after time he faces nature at its most extreme.

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People
programme.desc: Alaskan Bush People is an American docudrama-style reality TV series revolving around the Brown family, members of which are trying to survive in the wilderness, far away from the society. Take a journey deep into Alaska's bush, where naturalist and adventurer Billy Brown, along with his wife, Ami, and their seven children, choose to live life on their own terms, connected to wild nature and bonded to each other.

programme.title: My Cat from Hell
programme.desc: Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. These are attacks and misbehavior, and Jackson is a true cat-lover and a believer that any problem can be solved thanks to love, patience and proper handling. Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member.

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
programme.desc: US reality TV show follows the Irwin family through their adventures in continuing Steve Irwin's legacy. The family share their wildlife experiences from their travels across the world. They show how they care for all the animals while giving insight into their family life at Australia Zoo where they live and work. The Australian family including mother Terri who is a naturalist and conservationist stars alongside daughter Bindi and son Robert who are fully immerse in animal life and their family.

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: A behind-the-scenes look at the Bronx Zoo, one of the largest zoos in the USA and the largest city zoo the country has to offer. Opening their doors to camera crews, the daily operations of the world-famous animal sanctuary are revealed, as the staff keep their loving creatures healthy and happy. Renowned for its diverse collection of animals and wonderful exhibitions, the Bronx Zoo is one of the finest in the world, home to lions, bears, tigers, snow leopards, baboons, flamingos and many more extravagant species. This series showcases the effort, experience and expertise required to run the Bronx Zoo.

programme.title: The Aquarium
programme.desc: Reality-documentary series following the lives of the aquatic inhabitants at the Georgia Aquarium. The largest in the United States and fourth-largest in the world, the aquarium boasts a wide range of diverse inhabitants and explores the relationship between animals and trainers. The 10-million-gallon (38-million-litre) facility plays home to over 500 marine species including endangered penguins, rescued sea otters and recovering sea lions. The show reveals the difficulties that come with nursing and caring for such a wide variety of species. With many heart-warming scenes, the series beautifully reveals the friendships between the different species and how they learn to co-exist with each other.

programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
programme.desc: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet is a TV series entirely dedicated to love and care for animals. Thanks to a genius Dr. Jeff Young Denver's Planned Pethood Plus veterinary clinic is always busy and is taking care of 80,000-plus clients and their pets. Dr. Jeff's sharp surgical skills and his unconditional love for animals make him one of the most respected vets in the country. Dr. Jeff has a dedicated team of more than 30 veterinary staffers and once a month they go to remote locations where people do not have access to vets.

programme.title: Tanked
programme.desc: The Holiday season is here and so is another huge client for ATM. Zappos is an online sneaker and clothing company looking for a one of a kind tank. The CEO of Zappos feels his employees deserve a nap room. After all, it is peak season and they are working around the clock. Wayde and Brett accept the challenge to make a 24 ft long tank with individual sleeping pods. Will ATM be able to pull this off in time for the holidays or will they be sleeping with the fishes?

programme.title: Lone Star Law
programme.desc: Reality series, set in Texas and similar to ''North Woods Law'', that follows daily lives of men and women who are Game Wardens and whose job is to protect deserts, lakes, woods, bayous, coasts and wild animals that live in the second-largest state in the U.S. These people have their plates full as they must deal with poachers, hunters who don't obey the law, smugglers, while they rescue injured wildlife and defend citizens.

programme.title: The Vet Life
programme.desc: The Vet Life is an amazing series revolving around three friends, three vets, Diarra Blue, Aubrey Ross, and Mike Lavigne and their everyday lives. These guys became friends back in University, then they worked in Las Vegas and finally moved to Texas and opened a full-service veterinary hospital of their own. The series highlights their daily routine, their duties at work and at home, their families and pets.

programme.title: Treetop Cat Rescue
programme.desc: Climbing enthusiasts brother-in-law duo Shaun Sears and Tom Otto work together to rescue the felines that climb beyond capability and get stuck in Washington State. The experienced tree climbers do their best to rescue all of the cats they find out about whether a call comes in at day or night. With sometimes unfavourable weather, weak branches and bees nests to overcome the pair have to overcome obstacles and then have to avoid scaring the cats away as they approach.

programme.title: Treetop Cat Rescue

programme.title: Pit Bulls & Parolees
programme.desc: Pit bulls are eager to please, faithful and enthusiastic friends and pleasant with children according to credible canine organizations. But they have fallen from grace. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls.

programme.title: Insane Pools Off the Deep End
programme.desc: Insane Pools: Off the Deep End is a home improvement show that follows pool designer Lucas Congdon and his team from Lucas Lagoons. Congdon and his crew renovate existing pools and build new ones on residential properties. Thanks to their unbelievable imagination, creativity and professionalism they can turn every pool into an ultimate backyard oasis for a whole family and transform it into a natural lagoon. They prefer working with hand-selected stones from Tennessee.

programme.title: Sharks Of the Badlands
programme.desc: White sharks are infiltrating the waters off Cape Cod. Greg Skomal joins Kina Scollay in New Zealand to test new technology for shark detecting surveillance.

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People

programme.title: I'm Alive
programme.desc: I'M ALIVE features the death-defying and moving stories of people who — regardless of the obstacles or consequences — were determined to survive an animal attack. Driven by thoughts of loved ones and the desire to live, these individuals found the strength to survive terrifying and unexpected encounters by some of nature's most dangerous creatures. This inspirational drama combines victim interviews with true-to-life reenactments, giving a replay of the split-second decisions that saved lives. Over the course of 10 episodes, I'M ALIVE immerses viewers in the psychological experience of those involved, focusing on what pulled them through and what left them powerfully changed. Every survivor had something to live for, and in that fleeting moment of chaos, their desire for life outshone the attack.

programme.title: Preposterous Pets
programme.desc: In this programme, we delve into the stories of eccentric individuals who have developed a special relationship with unusual, exotic animals, ranging from giant alligators and polar bears to deadly scorpions and wild capybaras. Join us as we set out on a journey across the globe to meet these extraordinary pets and their owners.

programme.title: I Was Prey
programme.desc: Nature's great predators are animals you don't want to come across, especially when you find yourself in their own backyard. In this heart-pumping documentary series, individuals share their stories of encounters with dangerous animals, reliving the frightful, life-threatening ordeal. With stories from across the world, we reveal the heart-in-mouth moments when these lucky individuals managed to escape the jaws of death. From a swimmer mauled by a bull shark in the Bahamas to a close shave with a grizzly bear in the mountains, these stories showcase the fearsome power of predators.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: Chef Robert Irvine heads to Delray Beach, Florida, to work with Bobby, the owner of Taverna Trela, in hopes of reviving the flagging clientele. Assisting Chef Robert is the culinary mastermind Jason Giovanni and his sous chef, the swarthy Leonard Persin. Faced with maybe their greatest challenge yet, Chefs Robert and Jason race against the clock to save the restaurant from falling into the hands of rival chef, Jane "the Gain Goblin" Frantzen.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay
programme.desc: Two talented chefs go head-to-head for the chance to Beat Bobby Flay. To get to Bobby the chefs must first face off against each other, creating a spectacular dish with a secret ingredient of Bobby's choice. Judges Alex Guarnaschelli and Jeff Mauro know Bobby's strengths and his weaknesses. Their goal: Pick the chef who has the skills to take down Bobby Flay in his own arena. The winning chef gets to challenge Bobby with his or her surprise signature dish. If Bobby goes down, the winner can tell the world, "I beat Bobby Flay!"

programme.title: Summer Baking Championship
programme.desc: On the newest addition of the fan-favorite Baking Championship franchise, ten talented bakers from around the country tackle unique summer-themed baking challenges featuring the flavors, ingredients, and celebrations of the season for a chance to take home a $25,000 grand prize. Host Jesse Palmer puts the bakers' skills to the test to prove they can create the most delectable desserts to impress judges Duff Goldman, Carla Hall, and Damaris Phillips.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: Alex Vs America
programme.desc: Eric Adjepong hosts as experienced bakers and successful competitors Keya Wingfield, Melissa Yanc and Karina Rivera join forces to take down Chef Alex Guarnaschelli in a pastry battle. As the cuisines get even more difficult, Alex must use her expertise in gameplay to outthink and outcook her opponents. Stephanie Boswell and Sherry Yard judge the two rounds of competition, where the chefs have a chance to win up to $15,000, but only if they can defeat Chef Alex!

programme.title: 24 In 24
programme.desc: Featuring 24 talented and fearless chefs who take on 24 food challenges in 24 consecutive, non-stop hours, the 24-hour competition takes the chefs to the extreme, demanding they display the skills, creativity and stamina needed to be an elite chef.

programme.title: Next Baking Master: Paris
programme.desc: Bonjour, Paris! Stephanie Boswell and Ludo Lefebvre welcome ten bakers to Paris with their first challenge: make a dessert that represents their culinary point of view while demonstrating their knowledge of French techniques. Then, the bakers are whisked away to the luxurious Royal Monceau Hotel to meet pastry chef Quentin Lechat, sample his delicacies and learn about an iconic French ingredient: cream. Once they get back to the kitchen, they must demonstrate both technique and innovation as they create one showstopping cake that features two uses of cream.

programme.title: Summer Baking Championship
programme.desc: It's heating up in the kitchen, and Jesse Palmer wants to cool off with refreshing ice cream sandwiches with a bright summer inlay design! Then, Jesse brings all the childhood nostalgia when he drives an ice cream truck into the kitchen and asks the bakers to turn a classic confection into a high-end ice cream truck dessert before judges Carla Hall, Duff Goldman and Damaris Phillips bid one competitor a chilly farewell.

programme.title: Girl Meets Farm

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman

programme.title: Chopped

The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

These real life stories show the darker side of love and the deception it can lead to.

programme.title: The Curious Case of...
programme.desc: Master conman, Nicholas Alahverdian, aka Nicholas Rossi, fakes his own death to evade justice, adopts new identities and leaves a trail of alleged crimes across continents, now resurfaced as Arthur Knight, he spins his most audacious con in court.

programme.title: The Curious Case of...
programme.desc: The Curious Case Of… will dive into some of the most shocking true crime cases and unbelievable scandals. From a con man with multiple identities whose crimes stretch across the globe to a religious doomsday cult centered around worshipping cats, each episode will go inside these real-life cases exposing bizarre secrets, shattered lives, and twisted motives.

programme.title: Stranger Among Us
programme.desc: Stranger Among Us is an American crime drama series telling real-life stories about terrible murder cases that occurred inside well-established and close communities, like a tight circle of Chicago doctors, West-Virginia firefighters, or a group of train hoppers. After the communities welcome a mysterious newcomer strange things start to happen, revealing that not everything is as it seems. The answers always lead to one of the group members.

programme.title: Desperate Measures
programme.desc: Desperation is a powerful mental state and one that can push people down unimaginable paths. This documentary series examines stories in which individuals became consumed by their animalistic instincts, where they were backed into a corner and seemingly, from their perspective, left with no choice but to act on their emotions. When at their most vulnerable, humans can commit the most appalling of crimes.

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: Documentary series that tells true and often tragic stories of the crimes perpetrated on the internet and of deception and manipulation triggered by online interactions - from predators lurking behind Facebook profiles to maniacs searching for their victims in chat rooms. Series includes re-enactments, comments from law enforcement personnel, true-crime experts, psychologists and interviews from friends and families of the victims. Rare episodes feature victims who were extremely lucky to survive and are able to tell us what happened.

programme.title: Where Murder Lies
programme.desc: When a mother of three goes missing, the entire town of Renovo, Pennsylvania, searches far and wide for her. Eventually, two suspicious ransom notes and a chase across state borders lead police to a suspect who was under their noses the entire time.

programme.title: The Friday the 13th Murders
programme.desc: On Friday the 13th, a Satan-obsessed teen stalks a Texas town. As bodies fall, survivors fight and cops race to end the nightmare before dawn.

programme.title: Bodies In the Water
programme.desc: When a missing high school student is found dead in the Atlantic Ocean, investigators uncover jealous boyfriends and turmoil within her foster family.

programme.title: Dead on Arrival
programme.desc: American true crime documentary series exploring heinous murders of innocent people, whose only crime was moving from a small town to a big city. Full of hope and dreaming of a better life, these citizens have taken the plunge and upped sticks to an a bustling city, where it seems the world is their oyster. Establishing themselves in the city, their life seems to be on the up, until sinister killers tragically ended their lives. From an aspiring actress that left Eugene, Oregon to pursue a career in Hollywood, to a social worker fulfilling her New York dream after moving from Topeka, Kansas, these chilling tales reveal the dark sides to big cities.

programme.title: Dead Silent
programme.desc: This docu-series takes the viewer on a disturbing psychological journey into the dark and foreboding world of true crimes carried out in lonesome and desolate locations. From hikers hearing a twig snap in a remote forest, to a mysterious stranger disrupting a fishing trip at an isolated campsite, or a young couple's desperate fight for survival at a secluded lovers' lane, this series examines the terrifying reality of being alone in a life-threatening situation. Each episode focuses on one specific case and uses eyewitness accounts from survivors, expert analysis from criminologists and psychologists, and commentary from local authorities to provide context and authenticity to these truly horrifying tales.

programme.title: People Magazine Investigates
programme.desc: Investigation Discovery and People magazine partner to re-examine some of the most high profile crime cases in recent history. The one-hour series brings viewers tales of betrayal, buried secrets and unsung heroes, ripped from the pages of one of the nation's top weekly magazines. These stories transcended news and became part of pop culture, revealing shocking twists, new evidence, and unexpected resolutions. Interlaced within every episode are exclusive interviews with People's journalists, archival footage, re-creations, and firsthand accounts by those closest to the investigations.

programme.title: American Chopper
programme.desc: American Chopper is an American reality television series that revolves around the Teutuls- Paul Senior, his sons Paul Junior and Michael who work together at Orange County Choppers, a custom motorcycle fabrication company located in Montgomery, New York. The series is a mix of competition and drama, famous for real fighting, cursing, crying, welding, and painting. It's indisputable that each Teutul is a gifted mechanic, engineer and designer, they put together a motorbike in front of the viewers and make every customer's wish come true.

programme.title: Deadliest Catch
programme.desc: A documentary chronicling real life the adventures of one of the most deadliest professions in the world. Follow Alaskan crab fishermen as they face 40-foot waves and intense discomfort with freezing temperatures as they fish in the Bering sea. Sacrificing tooth and nail to catch the seasonal delicacies to later sell and trade on land. Witness the dangers these fisher men face as they battle against the sea, and experience how caution is a crucial part of staying alive.

programme.title: Street Outlaws
programme.desc: Reality series focuses on the amazing opportunity to dive into American street racing world. Look at how need for speed unites people and find out what adrenaline addicts are ready for in Oklahoma, unofficial capital of illegal street racing. Only top racers participate in the competition, they want to appear and stay at the A-list, everything they have to do is to try to squeeze as much performance out of their vehicles as possible.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters: The Restorers
programme.desc: Expert craftsmen are bringing Drew Pritchard's finds back to life and restore them to their former glory. Drew hunts for treasures such as derelict gems and forgotten remnants across the country. And then he and his team do the restoration turning trash to gold, so that worn objects become shining gems for which Drew's customers want to pay a lot of money. All kinds of items can and will be restored, starting from a century-old suitcase to an ancient coffee machine, from a ravaged carousel horse to a large railway clock.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers
programme.desc: Buy, repair and restore and then resell a classic car in order to make profit- this is what Wheeler Dealers is about. The budget is limited, though you can see some exclusive and rare cars. Mike Brewer, a British dealer chooses the car carefully and hands it over to the mechanic, first Edd China, later Ant Anstead to be fixed and upgraded. The hosts are real masters of their trade, it seems they can bring life even to a piece of metal. It does not matter if you are a life-long car enthusiast or do not even have a driving license you will admire the results of hard work from the beginning to the end of the long uneasy restoring process.

programme.title: How It's Made
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered how things that surround us every day are produced? Find out about the whole process from the beginning to the end in a documentary television series How It's Made. The series demonstrates how various items like clothing and accessories, food, industrial products, cars, musical instruments and many more are manufactured. Who would have thought how exciting it would be to watch a cupcake, formula 1 race car or gummy vitamins being made?

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: How Do They Do It? Ever wondered how the stripes get into toothpaste or how contact lenses are made? How do goods get from one country to another and then into our supermarkets? What are car tires made from and exactly why are plasma TV screens flat? Eating, drinking, driving, flying. These all are activities that we carry out with barely a second thought. But have you ever wondered what exactly goes into your teabag and how it got there? How does an airport handle hundreds of thousands of items of luggage each day? And just how can a car's airbag inflate so quickly? Every day – often without even realizing it – we come into contact with technology, be it in the bathroom, in the car or on the golf course. We take a look at how things work, and focus on some of the most amazing examples of everyday objects including the world's fastest elevator and the most expensive chocolate money can buy.

The old vehicles are restored and given second life. It is a risky business and the two always wonder if they manage to make profit this time.

programme.title: Overhaulin'
programme.desc: Overhaulin' is an American reality TV series about customizing cars. The main difference from the other shows of this type is detailed presentation of the technical process and import scene plus serious-minded approach to the car owner's needs. The hosts are Chip Foose and Chris Jacobs. The concept of the series is that the car owner is absolutely unaware of what's going on. His car disappears one day and the owner is convinced that it has been stolen, misplaced or lost at a mechanic's shop, or has been towed away by police. Chip Foose and a team of mechanics have a week to remake the car into a custom masterpiece. Each show ends up with the surprise reuniting of the owner and his customized baby on four wheels.

With the battle lines drawn, who will survive by designing and building the most innovative choppers?

The Kilchers demonstrate one-of-a-kind model of surviving in severe conditions of the last frontier. Enjoy amazing panorama views of Alaska, showing its various nature. Sitting in a comfortable chair in your warm apartment just try to imagine how it really is when electricity and running water is not inevitable fact of life. The Kilchers hunt, go fishing, garden, gather, raise livestock in order to survive Alaska's uncontrollable power and wilderness.

programme.desc: Master mechanic Ant Anstead goes back to basics as he buys, restores and sells old cars from a ramshackle barn. But this time, it's personal, as any profit made will help him renovate a 500-year-old farmhouse that he's bought for his parents to retire in.

programme.title: American Cartel
programme.desc: The 2003 murder of police officer Matthew Pavelka leads to an international manhunt, millions of dollars seized, multiple homicides, and the discovery of the Mexican Cartel's infiltration of a U.S. street gang.

programme.title: Kidnap and Rescue
programme.desc: Kidnap & Rescue is a provocative new series about kidnapping and the rescuers with the courage to go where no one else can – risking violent reprisal to reclaim innocent victims, inside our borders and beyond. Whether it's a high-profile executive being held for ransom, a child sold overseas or a DEA agent taken by a vengeful cartel, the hope of every victim lies in the hands of the few with the training and dedication to bring them home. Kidnap & Rescue takes Discovery Channel viewers deep into a shadow world of astonishing cruelty and terrifying extremes.

programme.desc: Features three doctors removing tumors from patients with extreme cases. Experts in their field and renowned surgeons, Dr. Kimberly Moore Dalal, Dr. Jason Cohen, and Dr. Ryan F. Osborne take on some of the most challenging cases of their careers. Patients from all over the world, are looking to get their lives back and these surgeons are their last hope. This intense series highlights unique patients, difficult surgeries, and life-changing procedures.

programme.title: My 3000-lb Family
programme.desc: Cousins Naomi, Drew and Chitoka nearly weigh a combined 2,000 pounds. With the help of Dr. Charles Procter Jr., the desperate cousins attempt to overcome anxieties and live healthier lives, and this series follows their progress. It begins with Naomi's mom, Beverly, undergoing weight-loss surgery, which she hopes will inspire her daughter, niece and nephew to follow her footsteps. Despite seeing the complications involved in her mom's recovery, Naomi is motivated by her dream to start a family. Drew, meanwhile, needs to realize how addictive his eating habits have become, and Chitoka – bed-bound for more than three years – must literally take steps forward before qualifying for surgery.

programme.title: Outdaughtered
programme.desc: 40 bottles a day, 420 diapers a week and feedings every three hours became the new normal for Danielle and Adam Busby when they welcomed home the only all-female set of quintuplets in the country. The family of three became a family of eight overnight, and TLC follows that incredible journey in the new series OutDaughtered. The series captures Danielle, Adam and their adorable 4-year-old daughter Blayke as they adjust to their new life, while trying to hold on to the identities and lives they had cultivated before the five new additions arrived. Following the hilarious and heartwarming antics of the entire family including Danielle's zany mother, Michelle, and her older twin sisters and their families, it's all hands on deck as the family relies on their tight-knit circle to make the most out of this incredible lifetime adventure.

programme.title: 7 Little Johnstons
programme.desc: Amber and Trent Johnston are living the American dream. They have been happily married for 14 years and have five children ranging from 6 to 13 years old. On paper, they might seem like your average family...yet in person, they attract a lot of attention.... because all seven members of the Johnston family – Amber, Trent, their two biological children, Jonah and Elizabeth, as well as their three adopted children, Anna, Emma and Alex – happen to have Achondroplasia Dwarfism. Together, these spunky seven make up the largest known family of Achondroplastic dwarfs in the world, and even describe themselves as "the real life seven dwarfs."

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress
programme.desc: Delves into the heart of world famous Kleinfeld Bridal where the staff face immense pressure to help each bride find the dress if her dreams. Take a peak at the brides as they try on their dream dresses! It brings us up close and into the dressing room as brides prepare for their big day. Moms, bridesmaids and friends all express their opinions and often frustrate both bride and staff. In the end though, most brides find that "dream dress" and walk down with their grooms into wedded bliss.

programme.title: Kitchen Boss
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. Each meal usually consists of a main course, a side dish and a dessert and Buddy is joined in the kitchen by members of his family to show us how it's done and to add authenticity. Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. The recipe for each dish can be found on the show's website.

programme.title: 90 Day Fiancé: Happily Ever After?
programme.desc: American reality series, a follow-up spinoff of ''90 Day Fiancé'' that features couples who have applied for or received a K-1 visa (available uniquely to foreign fiancés of U.S. citizens) and have ninety days to marry each other, follows some of the most famous and interesting couples from the original show and documents the ups and downs of their relationships after they got married. For some of these couples, the real drama is just starting because they barely know each other and they have to battle critics, doubters, and various obstacles on their road to love. Some of the couples that are featured on the show are Danielle and Mohamed, Melanie and Devar, Loren and Alexei, Kyle and Noon, Brett and Daya and Russ and Paola.

The show explores the intricacy of working with your family, and their interpersonal relationships with other employees. Watch as they create everything from classic wedding cakes to alien spaceships.

Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. The recipe for each dish can be found on the show's website.

programme.title: Outdaughtered
programme.desc: 40 bottles a day, 420 diapers a week and feedings every three hours became the new normal for Danielle and Adam Busby when they welcomed home the only all-female set of quintuplets in the country. The family of three became a family of eight overnight, and TLC follows that incredible journey in the new series OutDaughtered. The series captures Danielle, Adam and their adorable 4-year-old daughter Blayke as they adjust to their new life, while trying to hold on to the identities and lives they had cultivated before the five new additions arrived. Following the hilarious and heartwarming antics of the entire family including Danielle's zany mother, Michelle, and her older twin sisters and their families, it's all hands on deck as the family relies on their tight-knit circle to make the most out of this incredible lifetime adventure.

programme.title: 7 Little Johnstons
programme.desc: Amber and Trent Johnston are living the American dream. They have been happily married for 14 years and have five children ranging from 6 to 13 years old. On paper, they might seem like your average family...yet in person, they attract a lot of attention.... because all seven members of the Johnston family – Amber, Trent, their two biological children, Jonah and Elizabeth, as well as their three adopted children, Anna, Emma and Alex – happen to have Achondroplasia Dwarfism. Together, these spunky seven make up the largest known family of Achondroplastic dwarfs in the world, and even describe themselves as "the real life seven dwarfs."

programme.title: 90 Day Fiancé: Happily Ever After?
programme.desc: American reality series, a follow-up spinoff of ''90 Day Fiancé'' that features couples who have applied for or received a K-1 visa (available uniquely to foreign fiancés of U.S. citizens) and have ninety days to marry each other, follows some of the most famous and interesting couples from the original show and documents the ups and downs of their relationships after they got married. For some of these couples, the real drama is just starting because they barely know each other and they have to battle critics, doubters, and various obstacles on their road to love. Some of the couples that are featured on the show are Danielle and Mohamed, Melanie and Devar, Loren and Alexei, Kyle and Noon, Brett and Daya and Russ and Paola.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress
programme.desc: In Franc decides to take Silky Baugreet, a Mauritian born bride-to-be out of her comfort zone and we meet new Bridal Consultant Ciara O' Dowling. Sarah Wright from Waterford finally tries on wedding dresses after 13 years. Her excitement is infectious after a tough few months. Cork native Ciara Santry is doing all the wedding preparation herself as her fiancé is currently on a six-month tour of the Lebabon with the Irish Defence Forces.

programme.title: 1000-lb Sisters
programme.desc: With an average weight of over 1000lbs, nothing can support the Slaton sisters like they can support each other. With hopes of a healthier life, the sisters embark on a journey to drop enough weight that they qualify for a life changing bariatric surgery. Without the surgery, Amy will never be able to become a mother like she dreams of, and Tammy will be bedridden. After meeting with medical experts, the sisters strive to reach their goal but drama ensues as they struggle to stick to their healthy diets. Will the Slaton sisters stay on the right track and turn their lifestyles around?

programme.title: Cake Boss
programme.desc: Carlo's Bakery in Hoboken New Jersey create elaborate, elegant and interesting edible art cakes. Cake Boss follows the team, led by Buddy Valastro, as they design and create two of these masterpieces for all kinds of events and occassions. The show explores the intricacy of working with your family, and their interpersonal relationships with other employees. Watch as they create everything from classic wedding cakes to alien spaceships.

Despite her daily challenges, Baylen and her family aren't afraid to laugh and embrace the chaos that makes their everyday lives in West Virginia unique. With Baylen yearning for independence, she'll need to rely less on her family as she takes steps toward being in the world on her own.

programme.title: 90 Day Fiancé UK
programme.desc: Mel Giedroyc hosts an explosive Tell All with shocking revelations, big announcements and some surprising guests. As the couples all get together for the very first time to update us on what has been happening in their relationships, no one is holding back.

programme.title: Body Bizarre
programme.desc: Criss-crossing the globe, 'Body Bizarre' embarks on a voyage of discovery unlike any other. From India's child snake charmers to the world's hairiest girl, this series uncovers the real human stories behind the headlines. With deeply personal interviews and footage from the most unusual of day-to-day routines, it's an adventure through the truly astonishing. Six-year-old Liu Jiangli was abandoned by her parents as a two-year-old after being born with large black spots and fur on her face and body. Connie Culp became the first American to undergo a face transplant in 2008, after being shot in the face by her ex-husband. These stories, and others, explore what life is like for some of the world's most extraordinary individuals.

programme.title: My Feet Are Killing Me
programme.desc: Quarantining at home hasn't stopped everyone's favorite foot fixers from helping patients with their foot troubles. Dr. Brad and Dr. Ebonie are teaming up with the compassionate and intelligent Dr. Sarah Haller, who is joining the medical series and has been working alongside Dr. Brad for years, on all new episodes of My Feet Are Killing Me: First Steps. In the midst of a world shutdown by COVID-19, these dynamic foot doctors pledge to help shocking podiatric cases, one video call at a time. Each 30-minute episode will follow three patients as they undergo virtual consultations to begin their journey towards surgeries that will leave their feet radically transformed and their lives changed forever. COVID toes have nothing on these cases!

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz have picked up Adam's 1984 Toyota FJ40 Land Crusier, a famous Japanese off-roader. This powerful car set the standard for 4x4 vehicles taking on the competition with its 4 litre, straight 6 engine. Its owner bought the car and used it as his daily driver but when engine problems took the car off the road Adam was unable to repair it after developing a potentially life limiting disorder. Now the Car SOS boys have stepped in to get Adam's dream car back on the road and put a smile back on his face.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz have picked up a 1999 Subaru Impreza, a Japanese boy racer car that won titles on the rally tracks and the hearts of many adoring fans. Its two litre, boxer engine set it apart from its rivals. The car's owner Matt has loved Imprezas since he was a boy and bought his dream car 10 years ago as a restoration project but since developing a degenerative back condition which makes physical work almost impossible , his restoration ground to a halt. With Matt in constant pain and forced to give up his job as a carpenter his prized Subaru was put into a garage where it has sat, untouched, for the last few years. Now, Matt's family have contacted Car SOS asking for help in getting the Impreza on the road again.

programme.title: Inside Airport: Lost & Found
programme.desc: Airport workers find lost items, including a purse stuffed with jewelry, two competitive ballroom dresses, a headphone case holding $1,200 and a mysterious matching set of luggage stuffed with produce. In Alabama, an avid Unclaimed Baggage shopper shares some of her greatest finds, including a diamond ring she bought for $4,500 that's now worth $20,000.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: As part of a joint effort during Super Bowl LIV, dubbed "Operation Team Player," CBP and HSI seize more than 176,000 counterfeit items, and make multiple arrests related to human trafficking and drug smuggling. HSI Atlanta conducts a controlled delivery of a hollowed-out truck battery filled with 5 kilos of heroin. And HSI New York tracks a suspected drug courier, a.k.a. "Busy Bee", who is found to have pellets of cocaine concealed on his person.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Homeland Security Investigations Agents in Orange County perform 3 undercover drug stings leading to multiple arrests and the seizure of crystal meth, fentanyl, and firearms. JFK Agriculture Specialists seize and destroy prohibited food items. Customs and Border Protection in the Rio Grande Valley searches vehicles crossing the border and discovers bundles of cocaine hidden under the back seat of an SUV.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: With airplane travel becoming increasingly popular in a shrinking world and millions of passengers journeying this way every day, it is helpful to be aware of the potentail dangers involved. This show presents remarkable stories of some of the most catastrophic accidents in aviation history and investigates the causes of the accidents, what effect they had on the industry and the steps taken to ensure that they don't happen in the future. Each stand-alone episode features compelling re-enactments, expert analysis and interviews with those involved. The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Moments after taking off from a windswept Norwegian island, the pilots of Widerøe Flight 839 hear a disturbing noise and then struggle to keep their plane level. And—after only 65 seconds in the air—their twin turboprop nosedives into the North Atlantic, killing everyone on board. In the wreckage, investigators discover damage to a critical steering component. And when they learn that another Widerøe flight nearly met the same fate at Værøy's notoriously tricky airport, they diagnose a perfect storm of controversial decisions that put lives at ris

programme.title: Drain the Oceans
programme.desc: Maritime mysteries -- old and new -- come to life in this 10-episode series, combining scientific data and digital re-creations to reveal shipwrecks, treasures, and sunken cities on the bottom of lakes, seas and oceans around the world. Innovative technology allows viewers to see what lies on the floors of large bodies of water such as the Gulf of Mexico, the Nile, the Indian Ocean, the Baltic Sea and the Atlantic Ocean as if they had been drained. Then, in a quest to explain natural wonders and man-made catastrophes, stories tell of how vessels sank, what ancient geological formations reveal about life on Earth, where Nazi secrets now reside, and why so many continue to search for the legendary city of Atlantis.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of the Bible
programme.desc: Noah and the Great Flood is one of the Bible's best-known tales. Now, investigators seek to unravel the story's origins, which may predate the Old Testament. They explore some of the earliest cities in Mesopotamia, use the latest science to examine past climates, decipher clay tablets, and put an ancient blueprint of the Ark to the test. Immersive CGI brings this long-lost story to life.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of the Bible
programme.desc: The story of Exodus is one of the great biblical tales, but why does ancient Egypt play such a central role? We follow a new season of excavations to find answers. Teams brush away layers of earth to reveal a magnificent lost palace and decipher reliefs from the temple of one of Egypt's greatest pharaohs. New discoveries shed light on the period in which this biblical story was set.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur.

programme.title: Airport Mega Move
programme.desc: Istanbul's Ataturk airport, the home of Turkish Airlines for decades, is about to close. Across town, a new state-of-the-art airport will begin operations but with flights in high demand, they have just 12 hours to move everything to their new home. This massive logistical challenge is of a scale never before attempted. Once this colossal move is completed, Turkish Airlines' new home will be on track to become the busiest airport in the world.

programme.title: Mega Marine Machines
programme.desc: From deep-sea danger to mega holiday cruises, helping rivers flow and harvesting power, "Mega Marine Machines" goes deep, unlocking the ultimate challenges of our water planet. Every mystery of the sea, every danger, every unknown, is a technological challenge waiting to be overcome. Today adventurers, explorers, and fortune seekers are drawn more than ever before to the ocean. Our audience will travel the depth and breadth of our oceans in every gritty fast-paced episode - where cool new tools and technology are pushing the limits in an unforgiving, watery world.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: Compared to the number of suicides in the general population, suicidal pilots are almost statistically non-existent. But when they do emerge from obscurity to unleash their horrific plans on innocent passengers, the destruction they inflict is epic. A 737 cruising above an Indonesian jungle suddenly plummets from the sky. An Airbus A-320 crashes into the French Alps. And, Malaysian Airlines Flight 370 vanishes over the South China Sea, and remains one of the greatest aviation mysteries of all time.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt
programme.desc: Shrouded by mystery, the Lost Treasures of Egypt clears the sand away from your eyes in revealing the secrets of this Ancient Civilisation. From the Valley of Kings to the Pyramids of Giza, we uncover hidden tombs and foretell the stories of ruling pharaohs through the artefacts, that we find along the way. Following the excavations of international experts, we unearth historical context at various archaeological sites. At the end of this series, you should be enlightened with numerous Egyptian theories such as "mummification" and the 'Curse of the Afterlife'. With royalty as Tutankhamun and Cleopatra, we explore the impacts these figures had at the time and the lasting dynasty they have since left behind, for modern Egypt.

programme.title: Seconds from Disaster
programme.desc: The 1972 Munich Olympics holds significant promise, offering a chance to showcase a new Germany to a post-WWII world. However, this hopeful beginning meets a tragic end on September 5 at just after 4:00 AM when Palestinian terrorists kill two Israeli athletes and capture 9 others. As police struggle to handle the crisis, the terrorists anticipate their every move. By 1:30 AM on 6 September, the fighting finally stops, and all of the athletes, five terrorists and one German police officer are dead. With the circumstances behind the police's actions shrouded in mystery, one athlete's wife vows to uncover the truth. An anonymous source begins sending her copies of a classified German report investigating the police protocol. With the help of a hostage crisis expert who analyzes more than 3,000 files, the pieces of the puzzle begin to fit together. Supplemented by expert testimony, eye-witness and family member interviews, this gripping one-hour recount answers the most critical questions: How did the terrorists break into the Olympic village; how did the police's rescue plot go so terribly wrong; and how could this have been prevented?

programme.title: Seconds from Disaster
programme.desc: The series investigates historically relevant human-made and natural disasters from the last century. Each episode is dedicated to a particular gruesome accident, every minute of which is thoroughly analyzed and studied in order to present the reasons for its occurrence and circumstances of it. The program uses re-enactments, interviews with witnesses and survivors, and CGI to show the viewers how it happened in reality. All this is done to draw viewer's attention to these issues so that we make sure they won't happen again in the future.

programme.title: Seconds from Disaster
programme.desc: Tuesday, September 11, 2001, a temperate and nearly cloudless morning over the eastern United States. Millions of men and women ready themselves for work. Among them is an air traffic controller in Boston, Mass. Based on sheer intuition, he will break all protocol this morning, alerting the Air Force that a potential disaster is unfolding on his radar screen. Air Force Colonel Bob Marr, commander NEADS (North East Air Defense Sector] will scramble all he has to try and avert a catastrophe - but it will consist of only two F-15's that begin "searching for a needle in a haystack". Meanwhile, a group of 19 young men armed with simple box cutters literally fly under the radar into the World Trade Center , The Pentagon, and a Pennsylvania field. From the viewpoint of these two key theaters of action, Air Traffic Control and the U.S. Air Force, "Seconds From Disaster: 9/11" deconstructs, second-by-second, the tragic events and security lapses that led to the worst attacks on American soil since Pearl Harbor. The episode contains chilling testimony from the Air Force Colonel Bob Marr , Air Traffic Controller Dave Bottiglia, Ben Sliney, the man who makes the call to ground all the planes in the air over the U.S. and John Farmer Senior Counsel for the Presidential Commission. The question has to be asked: even on the day, could 9/11 been stopped?

programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz have taken on their smallest ever car and one of their biggest jobs, a 1958 Messerschmitt KR200 bubble car. The car's owner is 23 year old graphic designer Sam, he bought the car with his dad as a joint restoration project but when Sam was struck with a serious heart condition their plans were scuppered. Now, with Sam is still dealing with the consequences of his heart problems the Car SOS boys have stepped in to save this tiny Messerschmitt bubble car and help put a smile back on its owners face.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz have taken on the task of restoring a 1974 Mk1 Ford Capri. Its owner, 53 year old Helen, is a lifelong petrol head who bought her dream car nearly 8 years ago with the plan to strip it down and do full nut and bolt rebuild. However after a terrible accident Helen was left with heart problems and in constant pain from severe rheumatoid arthritis the restoration of her Capri was put on hold. Daughter Rebecca and son Rob called Car SOS help put their mother's car back on the road and the gleam back in her eye.

programme.desc: Peter Devereaux on juba aastaid erus olnud ning nautinud rahulikku ja üksildast pensionipõlve. Äkitselt on ta sunnitud end aga taas aktiviseerima, et aidata hättasattunud kolleegi. programme.title: Kodu keset linna
programme.desc: Seriaali keskmes on Tallinnas elav perekond - noor naine, tema keskealine mees ja nende väike poeg. Sarja intriigide käivitajaks on mehe eelmine perekond. Põnevust lisavad ka naabrid, sugulased ja tuttavad. Tegevus toimub tänapäeva Eestis ning sarjas, nii nagu ka päris elus, on armastust ja vihkamist, pettumust, leppimist, armukadedust ning huumorit. Sarja peaosatäitjateks on näitlejad Eesti erinevatest teatritest. Martin Veinmann kehastab sarjas pereisa Hannest, tema noort naist Helenit mängib Kleer Maibaum, perepea esimest naist Epp Eespäev ning pereisa tütart esimesest abielust kehastab Kadri Adamson

programme.title: TV3 uudised
programme.desc: TV3 uudistetoimetus võtab igal õhtul operatiivselt ja asjatundlikult kokku olulisemad päevasündmused nii Eestist kui ka mujalt maailmast. Kui igatsed uudistesaadet, mis on aktuaalne, täpne, pisut terav, südamlik ning kus saab ka grammikese nalja, siis õige valik on "TV3 uudised". "TV3 uudised" on eetris igal õhtul kell 19.00. Argipäeviti mahub tunniajasesse saatesse põhjalik ülevaade nii Eestist kui välismaalt. Räägime näiliselt keerulistest asjadest selgelt ja arusaadavalt - sest aega on. Uudistesaate juhid on Liina Kanarbik, Marek Lindmaa ja Tarmo Maiberg. Reportaaže otse sündmuskohtadelt toovad teieni Sirje Eesmaa, Allan Muuk, Sven Soiver, Virgo Pärn, Kadri Pikhof, Marie Metsur, Christina Veinberg ja Tiina Laura Kimmel.

programme.desc: Ameerika on üks huvitav riik, kus juba pikki aastakümneid suudavad lihtsausklike raha oma karmanisse pistes haljale oksale jõuda loendamatud teleevangelistid ja jumalasõna kuulutajad, üks häbematum kui teine. Kuid nad kõik kahvatavad impeeriumi ees, mille suutsid oma tegutsemisaastatel üles ehitada Jim Bakker (Oscari nominent Andrew Garfield) ja tema abikaasa Tammy Faye, keda kadestamisväärse veendumusega kehastab Jessica Chastain, kes on tõusnud selle rollisooritusega eelseisva Oscarite hooaja vaat et suurimaks favoriidiks parima naispeaosa kategoorias. Alati oma pühendumusega silma paistev Chastain kaob selgi korral tegelaskujusse jäägitult; juuresolevalt fotoltki on kindlasti näha rohkem Tammy Faye'd kui Chastaini. Läbi tema filigraanse osatäitmise siseneme maailma, kus tagasihoidlikest oludest pärit Tammy Faye Bakker ehitab ühes oma abikaasaga üles tõelise telejutlusimpeeriumi.

programme.title: Vabad mehed
programme.desc: Luuresalk on jäänud vaenlaste tagalasse lõksu ja omade hoiatamine pole võimalik. Pingelisele olukorrale vaatamata tunneb Kriis, et on viimaks ometi leidnud endale mõttekaaslased. Samal ajal ootab ülejäänud rühm kannatamatult luureinfot. Tüdimus ja teadmatus annavad hoogu aina teravamale võimuvõitlusele. Kohale saabub leitnant Hundimets, kellele kapten Kulli isetegevus on täiesti vastvõetamatu. Vaja on teha kriitiline otsus: kelle juhtimisel ja mis eesmärgiga kogu missioon jätkub?

programme.title: Kuidas ma kohtasin teie ema
programme.desc: Kuidas me kohtasin teie ema (How I Met Your Mother) USA 2005 komöödiasariOsades: Josh Radnor, Jason Segel, Cobie Smulders, Neil Patrick HarrisSelle kultussarja loojateks on Carter Bays ja Craig Thomas ning tegevus keskendub Tedile, kes otsib new Yorgis oma unistuste naist. Abiks on tal selles ta neli parimat sõpra. On aasta 2030. Ted Mosby räägib lugu, kuidas ta kohtas oma tütre ja poja ema. Lugu algab aastal 2005, kui 27-aastane arhitekt Ted, kelle parimad sõbrad Marshall ja Lily kihluvad pärast üheksat aastat kurameerimist, saab elule uue mõtte - leida endale naine. Sellest on ülimalt shokeeritud Tedi naistemehest sõber Barney. Ted on veendunud, et tema elu armastus on uudisteankur Robin, kuid lapsed tunnevad teda kui tädi Robinit. programme.title: East Harbouri kangelased

programme.title: Austraalia kullakütid
programme.desc: Kõrbekaevuritel on raskusi oma puhuri käivitamisega, Shane ja Rusty jahivad suuri kullakamakaid Fantasy Gullys ning Jacqui ja Andy surve jõuda kullani viib nad olukorrani, mis on elu ja surma küsimus.

programme.title: Rongide päästmine maa kuklapoolel
programme.desc: Me tutvume Lithgow raudtee töökojaga, mille meeskonnad pakuvad olulisi hooldus- ja remonditöid ning rikkeabi rongidele mõnedel Austraalie kõige raskematel ja tihedama liiklusega tööstusraudteedel.

programme.title: Austraalia kullakütid
programme.desc: Shane ja Russell püüavad oma hooaja päästa. Victoria Diggers on sunnitud naabri maa peal kaevama. Vennad Marcus ja Linden jäävad kõrbesse hätta.

programme.title: Suur kalapüügiseiklus
programme.desc: Kaks head semu - maailmarändurist õngitseja Ali Hamidi ning endine profijalgpallur ja innukas kalur Bobby Zamora - on asunud püügiretkele Briti saarte ümbruses.

programme.title: Tohutud tehnikavead
programme.desc: Sarjas paljastatakse eepilisi läbikukkumisi ja napikaid, ebaharilikest kuni naeruväärseteni välja, millest insenerid parema meelega ei räägiks. Analüüsime, mis võis valesti minna ja paljastame probleemide lahendusi.

programme.title: East Harbouri kangelased
programme.desc: Newfoundlandi tabab orkaanihooaeg. Kipper jookseb ajaga võidu, et päästa tursahooaeg ja kraanapraktikant pannakse proovile.

programme.title: Austraalia kullakütid
programme.desc: Üleujutus sunnib Kõrbekaevurid abi otsima, uus tehnoloogia juhatab Jacqui ja Andrew massiivse kullanoosini ning Shane Calegari naaseb Rusty aitamiseks Fantasy Gullysse.

programme.title: Austraalia kullakütid
programme.desc: Brent ja tema poeg Cayden alustavad seiklust leidmaks väga väärtuslikku kristalset kulda, Rändajad on sunnitud kaitsma oma maad uudishimulike silmade eest ning Sheryl ja Simon leiavad suure noosi.

programme.title: Kollanokkadest rekajuhid
programme.desc: Juhtide puudus ähvardab Austraalia majanduskasvu seisata, kuid püünele on tõusmas uus põlvkond kollanokkadest rekajuhte; neid juhendavad juba kogenud ametikaaslased, kes on valmis teatepulka edasi andma.

programme.title: Yukoni kuld
programme.desc: Keni ja Guillaume'i probleemid seadmetega tähendavad seda, et nad sõeluvad läbi vaid poole vajalikust, Karl peab tegelema masinaveaga ja Bernie viib oma töö mujale lootuses, et õnn pöördub.

programme.title: Austraalia kullakütid
programme.desc: Gold Devils peab võidujooksu elementidega, Jacqui ja Andrew tungivad uutesse äärmustesse ja mehaanilised probleemid jätavad Feralid lõhestatuks.

programme.title: Austraalia kullakütid
programme.desc: Alan ja Salty satuvad kõrvalises Kimberley piirkonnas tupikusse, Vince, Bibi ja Murray peavad Victorias leidma uusi lahendusi ja Gold Retrievers näeb vaeva oma tõrgeterohkete pesuvabrikuga.

programme.title: Autsaideritest rekkajuhid
programme.desc: Jälgime väikest, aga võimekat Dale Kristenseni, kes on rekkajuht ja meistrimees. Kui Dale üritab pojale luua paremat tulevikku, seisab ta silmitsi seljaoperatsiooniga, mis võib ta plaanid purustada.

programme.title: Jäätunud kuld
programme.desc: Gröönimaa karm talv on kiiresti kätte jõudmas. Ray ja tema meeskond on 12-nädalase kaevandamishooajaga poole peale jõudnud. Oluline teave annab üllatavaid tulemusi.

programme.title: Yukoni kuld
programme.desc: Keni ja Guillaume'i probleemid seadmetega tähendavad seda, et nad sõeluvad läbi vaid poole vajalikust, Karl peab tegelema masinaveaga ja Bernie viib oma töö mujale lootuses, et õnn pöördub.

programme.title: Austraalia kullakütid
programme.desc: Feralsis on kokkuvarisemise äärel, Shane ja Russell võivad saada oma hooaja rikkaima kullatüki ning Jacqui ja Andrew võitlevad tagasilöögiga, mis võib nende viimase tehingu rikkuda.

programme.title: Austraalia kullakütid
programme.desc: Poseidoni meeskonnal hakkab 1000-untsise tüki leidmise aeg otsa saama, Gold Retrieversid püüavad põgeneda suvekuumuse käest ning Goldtimerid astuvad vastu äärmustele ja paljastavad tohutu saagi.

programme.title: Jaht sisemaa kullale
programme.desc: Otsides miljardite dollarite väärtuses kulda, avastab ajaloolane Tanya šokeeriva uue teooria, mis pöörab jahi ida suunas.

programme.title: Ameerika karmimad vanglad
programme.desc: Mississippis Leake'is asuv vangla on võimete piiril, kui metamfetamiinikuriteod sagenevad. Šerif Atkinson võitleb narko sissetoomise vastu, samas kui kinnipeetavad üritavad keelatud aineid smugeldada.

programme.title: Mõrvarlikud mafioosod Colin McLareniga
programme.desc: Vincent Gigante vääris Oscarit, kolmekümne aasta vältel teeskles ta vaimuhaigust, et õigusemõistmisest pääseda. Aga kui sellest läbi nähti, tundis ta kergendust, kui ta trellide taha pandi.

programme.title: Pahatahtlik ehitus
programme.desc: Mis juhtub, kui teadlased, leiutajad ja insenerid muutuvad pahalasteks: alates peidupaikadest ja uhketest häärberitest kuni saadaolevatest materjalidest valmistatud ja kõrgtehnoloogiliste seadmeteni.

programme.title: Kalliskivikütid Austraalias
programme.desc: Michael ja Cherie on otsustanud heade tingimuste korral oma pinnanõudest maksimumi võtta ning Ray ja Paul lähevad maa alla, lootuses leida roheline safiir.

programme.title: East Harbouri kangelased
programme.desc: Suured tormid tõstavad panuseid, kui meeskonnad võtavad laevu veest välja, transpordivad ohtlikku lasti ja leiavad imelisi süvavee koralle.

programme.title: Austraalia kullakütid
programme.desc: Mackie'd saavad kuuekohalise pakkumise oma kullarendile, Rändajad on sunnitud oma uhkuse alla neelama, et oma tegevusega jätkata, ning metsapõlengud sunnivad Jacqui ja Andrew uude asukohta.

programme.title: Kadunud
programme.desc: Kui usaldusväärne 17-aastane Macin Smith ei tule koolist koju, kas see on teismelise mäss? Või on ta elu ohus? Tema rahakotti peidetud sedel teeb pere murelikuks. Politsei püüab kokku panna puslet, samal ajal kui ta perekond on lootust kaotamas.

programme.title: Pilvede all
programme.desc: Sirje on Gunnari lahkumisest löödud ning Inna püüab talle toeks olla. Kuid samal ajal on kadunud ka Urmas... Andres kohtub Maimut külastades ootamatult ka Erikuga. Mammu leiab uusi sõpru, kuid Mariga tuleb sellest pahandus. Sirje saab teada, kuhu Gunnar sõitis. Andres hoiatab Kertut.

programme.title: Esmakohtingud teismelistele
programme.desc: Tulnukatehuviline Aliya tuleb teist korda kohtuma UFO-huvilise Joshiga.

programme.title: Armastuse hind
programme.desc: Ferit tuleb Zerrinit tänama, et too Esme vastu süüdistust ei esitanud. Esme teatab Kazimile, et tal on hea meel temast lahutada. Kaya saabub Tariki juurde, et rääkida läbi tema plaanid Seyrani suhtes. Seyran saab Tarikilt videokõne, kus on näha, et Kaya on kinni võetud. Teel koju ähvardab Tayyar Esmet relvaga ja röövib naise.

programme.title: Kodus ja võõrsil
programme.desc: Fenomenaalselt edukas ja pikaealine Austraalia draamasari ookeani-äärse väikelinna Summer Bay elanike rõõmudest ja muredest, armumistest ja südamete purunemistest. Sarja trumbiks on haaravad ja inimlikult usutavad tegelaskujud, kelle eludega on vaatajal kerge samastuda. Tegelaste galerii on ka piisavalt mitmekesine, et igaüks leiaks endale lemmiku, kellele kaasa elada - siin on nii teismelisi, noori täiskasvanuid kui ka juba küpsesse keskikka jõudnud peategelasi. Lisaboonuseks on Summer Bay igikestev päikesepaiste, mis rõhutab sarja positiivsust ja elurõõmu.

programme.title: Briti parim pagar
programme.desc: Pagarid väldivad soolaseid pirukapatse valmistades nätskeid põhju, aga kelle küpsetis kohtunikud keeletuks jätab? Ja kelle pilgupüüdjast pirukad jäävad tema hüvastijätuks?

programme.title: Unelmate hotell
programme.desc: Markus kavatseb tütre Leoniega Seishellidel mõnusa puhkuse veeta. Muret hakkab tekitama Helena Kaufmann, kes on pärinud osa maatükist, millel asub Markuse tädi hotell. Kas tegemist võib olla eksitusega ja ilmsiks tuleb midagi sootuks ootamatut? Seegi kord püüab kaunis paigas armastusele uut tuult sisse puhuda üks paar. Sekeldustest ei pääse ka Markuse tütar Leonie oma sõbrannaga.

programme.title: Armastus on keeruline
programme.desc: Romantiline komöödia! Leah on suhtes tasakaaluka ja igati rahuliku Edwardiga ning ta usub, et nii jääbki. Kui Leah kohtub Edwardi kingitud konfliktilahendamise kursusel värvika ja reljeefse raadiohäälega, hakkab ta oma elu valikute üle järele mõtlema.
